description.zh: 动态分组规则，用于查询并动态匹配设备到分组。规则表达式编写方法，请参见[类SQL语法说明](~~185713~~)。
description.en: Dynamic group rule used to query and dynamically match devices to the group. For information about how to write rule expressions, see [SQL-like Syntax Description](~~185713~~).

description.zh: 分组描述。长度不超过100个字符，一个中文占一个字符。
description.en: Group description. The length must not exceed 100 characters, with each Chinese character counting as one character.

description.zh: 分组名称。名称长度为4~30个字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文占两个字符。
description.en: Group Name. The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明

- 目前仅华东2（上海）地域下，企业版实例和新版公共实例，支持创建动态分组。实例详细说明，请参见[实例管理](~~147356~~)。

- 单个阿里云账号下最多可创建10个动态分组。

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为1。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

- You can create dynamic groups only for Enterprise instances and new public instances in the China (Shanghai) region. For more information about instances, see [Instance Management](~~147356~~).

- You can create up to 10 dynamic groups under a single Alibaba Cloud account.

- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for calling this API under a single Alibaba Assistant Cloud account is 1.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-device-dynamic-group --iot-instance-id iot-000 --group-desc test --group-name grouptest --dynamic-group-expression product_key_=_a1000_and_name_LIKE_test% --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateDeviceDynamicGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName grouptest --IotInstanceId 'iot-000' --GroupDesc test --DynamicGroupExpression 'product_key_=_a1000_and_name_LIKE_test%'
